C0469.title: Ctrip Supplier Illegally Redeemed Miles for Tickets, Leaving Passenger Under Investigation
C0469.summary: In January 2016, a traveler who booked a flight through Ctrip was investigated by police while boarding in Tokyo after the ticket was found invalid. The supplier had improperly redeemed someone else's airline miles to issue the ticket and resold it, exposing regulatory gaps in how ticket agents exploit mileage resale for profit.

references.title: Passenger buys 'fake ticket' on Ctrip, investigation reveals regulatory gaps in mileage resale | Jiemian News
